testCase.name: [local] S12 Hospital retention: day 2, the 18 h label and the 36 h clear (±1 h), held clock refreshed by processing

descriptionHtml:
Bug B04 · P0 · new

A pre-round Save Note with no vitals re-stamps yesterday's BP, creatinine and one-time doses with today's time ('Given · Oct 13' becomes today), so old values look current and never expire

Tickets: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92597 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Re-check on the PR #100/#101 branch Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745): TC-10/S12 cp3 / cp8 show the same mechanism after a summary retry: yesterday's temperature and BP stay on the panel, dated today.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S12

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S12 Hospital retention: day 2, the 18 h label and the 36 h clear (±1 h), held clock refreshed by processing

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U14a Hospital medication windows as the physician sees them: active rows show 'not mentioned today' from 18 h; active, held and stopped rows leave the Medications panel and the tracker at 36 h; … (UAT TC-19 ER 10; UAT 3.6 (Hospital medication rows); TFA-92597 R6; TFA-92597 AC 1)
  • U14b A cleared medication row is a real deletion (queryable as gone, not a hidden flag), the purge runs on the server without any client opening the chart (convex/crons.ts has only the session sweep; … (UAT 3.6 (windows are configuration values); UAT 3.7 (retention claim); UAT OAT-04 (B); TFA-92597 AC 5; TFA-94699 table; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U8 Hold/stop dates and reasons are the ones dictated and are kept on every later save; they are never changed to the save date. (UAT TC-19 ER 5; UAT TC-19 ER 10; TFA-92597 R6)
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched. (UAT TC-19 ER 8; TFA-92597 R2)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital chart processed at T0 with four rows: metoprolol active (mentioned at T0), lisinopril held at T0 'soft BP', vancomycin stopped at T0 'AKI', magnesium Given at T0. Variant A: nothing after T0. …

When Age the chart to T0+17 h, +19 h (day 2: also a silent Save & Extract 'Doing well, plan unchanged.'), +35 h and +37 h; at each point read rounding:get on the server BEFORE any device opens the app, then open Pre-Round and Post-Round → meds

Then 17 h: no label. 19 h: metoprolol (and magnesium, Q3) show 'not mentioned today'; held and stopped rows do not; after the silent day-2 save lisinopril still reads Held · <day-1 date> 'soft BP'. 35 h: all four present. 37 h, variant A: all four rows gone from the server record, not hidden. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Panel cells (17 h: no label; 19 h: the label on metoprolol and magnesium only, lisinopril still Held · <day-1 date> 'soft BP' after the silent day-2 save; 35 h: all four shown; 37 h variant A: none shown; 37 h variant B: held and stopped kept with their original date and reason, metoprolol and magnesium gone) are judged under U14a (UAT ER 10 / 3.6, TFA-92597 R6; …

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (manual)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92597 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress

A one-time dose given yesterday (Magnesium, 'Given · Oct 13') is re-dated to today when the physician saves an unrelated pre-round note, so it stays on the Medications panel past 36 h instead of expiring.

Evidence: Allure ac2e47ab, TIME lane: 9 of 11 cells passed. New and ungated (U14a/U8). In src/domain/medications.ts, mergePreRoundMedications (lines 491-503 and 532-550) restamps a single-dose row that the extractor only echoes back. Seen in 2 of 2 live runs and confirmed with a pure-function check. Separately (U14b, gated by TFA-94699 in progress): rows stay on the server until a client calls applyLifecycle. Not in the dev report, ledger or matrix.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-19 Medication Tracker · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-19/S12

Hospital retention: day 2, the 18 h label and the 36 h clear (±1 h), held clock refreshed by processing

Tickets: TFA-92597 Medication Tracker (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane manual: status failed in manual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): api + chromium spec. Chart processed at T0 with metoprolol active, lisinopril held 'soft BP', vancomycin stopped 'AKI', magnesium Given. Variant A aged to 17/19/35/37 h (server read before lifecycle, then lifecycle, then the Pre-Round Medications panel at 17 h and 19 h, the label read from each row's own DOM container (aging.ts medRows), with a reader-control chart at 19 h whose active Changed row with a reason line must carry the label). Variant B: T0 at 37 h with a real pre-round Save Note at T0+30 h (real AI parse of a silent text through the UI, then aged 7 h); the Save & Extract cells recorded; manual panel edit cell recorded; Generate cell not run (forbidden locally). Day-2 silent Save & Extract 'Doing well, plan unchanged.' at 19 h through the UI (real extract), then the lisinopril tag is read. — All cells but Generate run; the Generate cell is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json forbidden: generate) and runs on dev only.

Detail:

9/11 judged cells pass, 4 recorded, 1 NOT RUN. Fail: 37 h variant A: rows gone from the server record before any device opens the chart (no purge waits for a client) [U14b; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | 37 h, pre-round Save Note at 30 h: metoprolol and magnesium (last mentioned T0) gone [U14a]. Not run: 37 h, Generate at 30 h (Generate is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json forbidden: generate); dev only). Recorded: 19 h: magnesium (Given) label (Q3) = "label shown" | 37 h, extract-event at 30 h (Q5) = {"held":true,"stopped":true,"metoprolol":false,"magnesium":false,"message":"✓ Tasks updated — 1 added, 1 medication change"} | 37 h, extract-none at 30 h (Q5) = {"held":false,"stopped":false,"metoprolol":false,"magnesium":false,"message":"✓ Notes saved — no new tasks or medication changes found"} | 37 h, panel-edit at 30 h (Q5) = {"held":true,"stopped":true,"metoprolol":false,"magnesium":false,"message":"panel save"}.

Product issue: NEW (U14a / U8, no gate). A silent pre-round Save Note re-dates yesterday's one-time dose. The chart was processed at T0 with 'Magnesium sulfate 2 g IV once', shown as Given · Oct 13. At T0+30 h the physician saves the pre-round 'Overnight uneventful. No complaints this morning.' The row now reads Given · Oct 14 (today) and its updatedAt is restamped to now, so at 37 h it is still on the Medications panel, when it should have left with metoprolol (last mentioned at T0). Seen in 2 of 2 completed live runs (a third attempt, report-142730, timed out). Root cause: src/domain/medications.ts mergePreRoundMedications (e02167f, the echo guard at lines 491-503 and the restamp at 532-550) skips a row the extractor only echoes back from the names on file only when the echo says st === 'active'. A single-dose row that comes back is restamped: changeDate = today (isSingle → stampDate2) and updatedAt = now, which also breaks the function's own comment ('neither is a row it only echoes back'). Checked by calling the pure function (scratchpad merge-echo.ts): an echoed 'Magnesium sulfate' (single-dose) is re-dated to Oct 14; an echoed active metoprolol is untouched; an empty answer leaves the row alone (as the socket-mocked diag run on the app showed). Breaks UAT TC-19 ER 8 (a one-time dose shows as Given and expires), ER 10 / 3.6 (36 h window), and the TC-19 AI check (no change dictated → no row changed). Also seen (gated, TFA-94699 in progress, U14b): at 37 h the four rows are still on the server record until a device runs rounding:applyLifecycle; convex/crons.ts has only the session sweep.

During the run (runNote): Variant A re-run 15:58 JST with the per-row DOM label reader (the text-split reader stopped at each row's own tag line). evidence/TC-19-S12/diag-row.json: the same silent Save Note with the parse answered at the socket with no medications leaves the Given row untouched, so the re-dating comes from the model's answer and the merge accepting it. Variant B: 2 of 2 completed live runs re-dated the row (a third attempt, report-142730, timed out).

Evidence: 15 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (moving a chart's stamps back, a test-only internal mutation called with the local stack's admin key) plus legs and variants; dev has no admin key and the dev runner calls no function but the listed queries and seed mutations (runner-contract §10.2), so this stays on the lo…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
